headline_zh: 16/16 (100.0%) 确定性拦截 x402 XRPL Upto/CORS 预检/自付款刷量、UCP 订阅总额污染/未绑定签名重放、Stripe MCP 代理元数据丢失/挂起与 τ-bench 分母逃逸
headline_en: 16/16 (100.0%) Deterministic Defense Across x402 XRPL Upto/CORS/Self-Pay, UCP Purchase Options/Response Binding, Stripe MCP Proxy & τ-bench Scoring

scenarios.title_zh: x402 XRPL `upto` 支付通道、`OPTIONS` 预检放行与浏览器 CORS 头方向校验通过
scenarios.title_en: x402 XRPL `upto` PayChannel, `OPTIONS` Preflight Bypass & Browser CORS Valid Pass
scenarios.task_zh: 校验 `xrpl:1` 通道 `CLM\0` 签名、`CancelAfter/SettleDelay >= maxTimeout+20s`、`OPTIONS` 204 预检与双向 CORS 头
scenarios.task_en: Verify `xrpl:1` `CLM\0` claim signature, `CancelAfter/SettleDelay >= maxTimeout+20s`, `OPTIONS` 204 preflight & CORS header lists
scenarios.reason: x402 XRPL upto, CORS preflight/header directionality, and anti-wash invariants verified.

scenarios.title_zh: x402 XRPL `upto` `/verify` 阶段客户端夹带 `settlementTransaction` 阻断
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截客户端在 `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` 中注入仅限服务端 `/settle` 签发的 `settlementTransaction` (`#3023`)
scenarios.task_en: Block client payload presenting settle-only `settlementTransaction` at `/verify` (`#3023`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Facilitator /verify must reject client payloads carrying settlementTransaction (#3023).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 XRPL `upto` `/settle` 零结算或预付超额时未省略 Claim 字段裸关通道阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 XRPL `upto` Pre-Delivered / Zero Settlement Missing Bare Close Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截当 `channelBalance >= settleAmount` 或零结算时仍携带 `Balance/Amount/Signature` 而非裸 `tfClose` (`#3023`)
scenarios.task_en: Block carrying `Balance/Amount/Signature` instead of a bare `tfClose` when `channelBalance >= settleAmount` (`#3023`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Zero settlement or pre-delivered charge (Balance >= settleAmount) must use a bare tfClose omitting Balance/Amount/Signature/PublicKey (#3023).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 无方法通配路由将浏览器 `OPTIONS` CORS 预检误判为 `402` 付费请求阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 Method-Less Route Answering `OPTIONS` CORS Preflight with HTTP `402` Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截通配路由 `* /path` 对浏览器 `OPTIONS` 预检返回 HTTP `402` 导致真实付费请求无法发出 (`#3738`)
scenarios.task_en: Block wildcard route `* /path` returning HTTP `402` on browser `OPTIONS` preflight (`#3738`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Method-less wildcard routes must skip OPTIONS preflight and let CORS middleware answer instead of returning HTTP 402 (#3738).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 Facilitator 自付款刷量 (`payer === payTo` 大小写不敏感) 阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 Facilitator Self-Payment Wash Settlement (`payer === payTo`) Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截 `payer` 与 `payTo` 相同（零净经济价值转移）的自结算刷量与目录自索引滥用 (`PR #3910`)
scenarios.task_en: Block circular wash settlement where `payer` equals `payTo` (`invalid_self_payment`, `PR #3910`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Facilitator verify/settle must reject self-payments where payer equals payTo with invalid_self_payment (PR #3910).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 批量结算退款缺失 `Refunded` 事件假阳性成功阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 Batch-Settlement Refund Missing `Refunded` Event Fail-Closed Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截链上回执未发出匹配 `channelId` 的 `Refunded` 金额事件却报告退款成功 (`#3096`)
scenarios.task_en: Block reporting refund success when receipt emits no matching `Refunded` amount (`#3096`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Batch-settlement refund must fail closed when receipt emits no matching Refunded amount (#3096).

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 结账生命周期双向迁移、`purchase_options` 订阅与请求绑定签名放行
scenarios.title_en: UCP Checkout Lifecycle (`#672`), `purchase_options` (`#890`) & Request-Bound Signature Valid Pass
scenarios.task_zh: 校验 `ready_for_complete -> requires_escalation`、未来周期订单零计入结账 `totals`、签名绑定请求及幂等键一致
scenarios.task_en: Verify `ready_for_complete -> requires_escalation`, recurring schedules excluded from `totals`, request-bound signature & idempotency
scenarios.reason: UCP checkout status lifecycle, purchase_options subscription policy, request-bound response signature, and idempotency verified.

scenarios.title_zh: UCP `purchase_options` 将未来周期性订单 (`schedules`) 金额计入当前结账 `totals` 阻断
scenarios.title_en: UCP `purchase_options` Including Future Recurring Order `schedules` in Checkout `totals` Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截将后续由商家代下的周期性订阅订单金额计入当次结账 `totals` (`PR #890`)
scenarios.task_en: Block adding future recurring order `schedules` amounts to current checkout `totals` (`PR #890`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Recurring order schedules represent future Orders; nothing is owed at checkout and they must not be added to totals (PR #890).

scenarios.title_zh: UCP REST 签名响应未绑定请求 (`@method`/`@target-uri`) 遭中间层重放旧价格阻断
scenarios.title_en: UCP Signed REST Response Unbound to Request Stale Price Replay Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截仅签名 `@status`/`content-digest` 而未绑定原请求，防止网关重放提价前的 `$40.00` 旧签名 `200` 响应 (`PR #699`)
scenarios.task_en: Block signed REST response unbound to originating request (`@method`, `@target-uri`, freshness) (`PR #699`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Signed REST responses must bind to the originating request (@method, @target-uri, freshness) to prevent intermediary stale replay (PR #699).

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 仅目标标识操作 (`cancel_checkout`) 跨资源复用幂等键阻断
scenarios.title_en: UCP Target-Only Operation (`cancel_checkout`) Cross-Resource Idempotency Key Reuse Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截将绑定 `chk_123` 的 `cancel_checkout` 幂等键复用于 `chk_999` 而不报错 (`PR #782`)
scenarios.task_en: Block reusing an idempotency key bound to `(cancel_checkout, chk_123)` against `chk_999` (`PR #782`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Reusing an idempotency key with a different operation or target resource identifier must be rejected without executing (PR #782).

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe 本地 MCP 代理保留工具元数据、转发失败快返错误与 MCP `SEP-3415` 放行
scenarios.title_en: Stripe Local MCP Proxy Metadata (`#584`), Fast-Fail Error (`#542`) & MCP `SEP-3415` Valid Pass
scenarios.task_zh: 校验 `registerTool` 保留 `title/annotations`、401 转发失败立即回传 JSON-RPC 错误、`mcp<2` 及 `SEP-3415` 游标
scenarios.task_en: Verify `registerTool` preserving `title/annotations`, immediate JSON-RPC error on 401 failure, `mcp<2` & `SEP-3415` cursor
scenarios.reason: Stripe local MCP proxy metadata, fast-fail JSON-RPC error forwarding, Python dependency bounds, and MCP SEP-3415 Events verified.

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe 本地 `@stripe/mcp` 代理丢弃远端工具 `title` 与安全 `annotations` 阻断
scenarios.title_en: Stripe Local `@stripe/mcp` Proxy Dropping Remote Tool `title` & `annotations` Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截本地代理使用旧 `this.tool(...)` 导致 `create_refund` 等工具丢失 `destructiveHint`/`readOnlyHint` (`PR #584`)
scenarios.task_en: Block local proxy dropping remote tool `title` and `annotations` (`destructiveHint`, `readOnlyHint`) (`PR #584`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Local @stripe/mcp proxy must use registerTool to preserve remote tool title and safety annotations (PR #584).

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe `@stripe/mcp` 转发请求至 `mcp.stripe.com` 失败 (HTTP 401) 时静默丢包挂起 60 秒阻断
scenarios.title_en: Stripe `@stripe/mcp` Silently Dropping Failed JSON-RPC Request (60s Client Hang) Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截 `httpTransport.send()` 抛出 HTTP 401 等异常时仅写 stderr 而不向客户端回传 JSON-RPC Error (`PR #542`)
scenarios.task_en: Block stdio proxy silently dropping a failed JSON-RPC request instead of returning a JSON-RPC error (`PR #542`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: When forwarding a JSON-RPC request to mcp.stripe.com fails (e.g., HTTP 401), the stdio proxy must immediately return a JSON-RPC error instead of hanging 60s (PR #542).

scenarios.title_zh: Sierra τ-bench 2.0 非对象工具参数计入 `AGENT_ERROR`、零售无内部 ID 泄露与语音榜单放行
scenarios.title_en: Sierra τ-bench 2.0 `AGENT_ERROR` Scoring (`#674`), Retail Clean `known_info` (`#677`) & Voice Pass
scenarios.task_zh: 校验非 JSON 对象工具参数判为 `AGENT_ERROR`（保留分母）、`Mei Kovacs` 自然姓名与 `Ava Zero`/`phonic-1` 发布日期
scenarios.task_en: Verify non-object tool args scored as `AGENT_ERROR`, natural name `Mei Kovacs` in `known_info` & `Ava Zero`/`phonic-1` release date
scenarios.reason: Sierra tau2-bench 2.0 AGENT_ERROR scoring, retail known_info user_id leak guard, and voice release metadata verified.

scenarios.title_zh: Sierra τ-bench 将畸形工具参数 (`42`/`null`/`[]`) 或空回复误记为 `INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR` 剔除分母阻断
scenarios.title_en: Sierra τ-bench Misclassifying Malformed Tool Call / Empty Reply as `INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR` Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截模型输出非对象 JSON 参数或空回复时逃逸为 `INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR` 从而被从 2.0 得分分母中剔除 (`PR #674`)
scenarios.task_en: Block agent-generated malformed tool arguments or empty replies escaping as `INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR` and dropping from denominator (`PR #674`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Malformed/non-object tool-call arguments and empty agent replies must terminate as scored AGENT_ERROR (0.0), never INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR dropped from denominator (PR #674).

scenarios.title_zh: Sierra τ-bench 零售场景 `known_info` 直接泄露内部用户 ID (`mei_kovacs_8020`) 旁路身份查询阻断
scenarios.title_en: Sierra τ-bench Retail `known_info` Leaking Internal User ID (`mei_kovacs_8020`) Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截在要求调用 `find_user_id_by_name_zip` 的零售任务提示中直接向 Agent 暴露内部 ID `mei_kovacs_8020` (`PR #677`)
scenarios.task_en: Block leaking internal user ID `mei_kovacs_8020` in `user_scenario.known_info` ahead of `find_user_id_by_name_zip` (`PR #677`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Retail user_scenario.known_info must state the user's natural name (Mei Kovacs) rather than leaking internal user_id mei_kovacs_8020 before find_user_id_by_name_zip (PR #677).
